posts.title: ‘Middle Powers Rising’
posts.description: 26 September, 2026. It was one of the key findings in the 2024 Global Diplomacy Index of the outstanding Lowy Institute (from which the title of this blog is a quote) that by 2023 Turkey and India had significantly expanded their networks of diplomatic and consular outposts. Since then, there has probably been a surge in the same direction, led above all by Canada. The post ‘Middle Powers Rising’
